name: Reaction identities and chemical accounting
description: Retrieve chemical/reaction identities and calculate explicit atom, electron, carrier and cofactor ledgers under a declared reaction boundary; leave unmeasured driving forces unknown.

capability_operations.operation: Retrieve selected chemical or reaction records

inputs.identifier_or_query: explicit Rhea accession/query or ChEBI accession/text

outputs.source_record: native equation sides/direction or chemical structures/relations with source identities

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Calculate a declared reaction or route ledger

inputs.reactions: specified stoichiometric species, charges, carrier forms and direction
inputs.boundary: included reactions and excluded precursor/regeneration steps
inputs.optional_measurements: reported potentials/concentrations with units and uncertainty

outputs.derived_values: arithmetic or conditional energy relation with assumptions and unknown terms

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Propagate declared isotope labels through a supplied reaction map

inputs.labels: positions and enrichment from identified source measurements
inputs.map: explicit atom correspondence and alternative routes

outputs.comparison: observed versus predicted labels without inventing flux estimates

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: gene_annotation_episode/tools.py:public.rhea.* and public.chebi.* catalog definitions; no registered general stoichiometric/thermodynamic calculator confirmed.
research_operations_performed: chemistry/raw/bcd_redox_arithmetic.json: descriptive arithmetic using paper potentials and stated boundary.
replacement/raw/route_bookkeeping_probe.json: BioZ/BioC and ThyX/ThyA route ledgers and growth-ratio arithmetic; not flux simulation.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: General ledger/isotope tools are capability specifications; new flux models, measured intracellular concentrations and membrane energetics are not supplied.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: Product identification, isotope-feeding and electron-transfer assays are source evidence from authors.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: Balanced or conditionally favorable chemistry does not show that a target performs it.
Keep NADH versus NADPH and chemical reducing equivalents distinct; excluded precursor costs remain excluded.
Observed approximate stoichiometry and idealized fully coupled reaction are different outputs.

observed_uses.execution_scope: Read-only calculation with stated assumptions; no new redox measurement.
